name: Đinh Bộ Lĩnh
role: Warlord who ended the era of the 12 warlords and founded Đại Cồ Việt as its first emperor
known_facts: Son of Đinh Công Trứ, a military officer under Dương Đình Nghệ; based in Hoa Lư, Ninh Bình
Rose during the Loạn 12 sứ quân, the chaos of twelve warlords after Ngô Quyền's line collapsed
Served the warlord Trần Lãm at Bố Hải Khẩu and was adopted as his heir, inheriting his army
Held Hoa Lư, a natural fortress of limestone karst and the Hoàng Long river, with the loyal 'Giao Châu thất hùng' including Lê Hoàn
Defeated or won over the twelve warlords in roughly three years, from 966 to 968, and was hailed as Vạn Thắng Vương
In 968 proclaimed himself emperor, named the country Đại Cồ Việt, made Hoa Lư the capital, and minted the Thái Bình hưng bảo coin in 970
Ruled with harsh law and a standing army of ten đạo under Thập đạo Tướng quân Lê Hoàn; buried on núi Mã Yên at Hoa Lư
interpretation: 10th-century Đại Cồ Việt warlord and founding emperor, based on the user reference.
unknowns: No verified contemporary life portrait survives
The childhood 'cờ lau tập trận' story is tradition, not documented record
